rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Short kerb at the bend where cars park; houses 10-16 m behind, steep.
reasons: Several cars park at this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 16 m behind at the start and 10 m behind at 11 m along, screened by garden trees and the big canopy tree further down.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerbside lane with cars parked on it in the Esri image; room to pull fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road on a bend with a junction below; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped. A row of cars sits at this kerb in the Esri image, so a van is not unusual.

flags: Steep: about 6% grade here, 8.9% mean, max 13.4% further down
House about 10 m away on the same side
sun_shade: Open to sun at the top; a large tree canopy shades the lower part of the stretch.
cannot_judge: Whether the parked cars are residents' or regular visitors

best_section.where: North kerb of Stanley Terrace at the top of the bend, where cars are parked in the Esri image
